leakage_group_exporter.portability_caveat: group IDs hash absolute resolved source paths and are not promised byte-identical after dataset-root relocation
leakage_group_exporter.semantics: transitive union of normalized source-family identity and near-visual matches using 64-bit dHash Hamming distance <=3 plus a quantized 16x16 colour-thumbnail threshold

predecessor_manifest.role: immutable lineage and identical-mapping comparison only

relation_graph.union_rule: transitive connected components of exact stem OR exact leakage_group OR abs(Image_N_i-Image_N_j)<=3

solver.tie_break: lexicographically smallest fold vector in canonical component order; try folds 0..4 and lock the first remaining-feasible fold

supersession.scope: provenance disclosure and immutable-write semantics only
